title: Fix Puzzle 3d Play Dev
description: puzzle 3d play dev server fails with Babel duplicate declaration BoardStructuralDeleteReporter in framework playground react renderer.
summary: Fixed puzzle 3d play runtime errors: imported registerWindowBody into playground renderer module scope (re-export alone did not bind locally). Normalized oklab computed colors via canvas for Three.js. Fixed Puzzle3dSelectionMissBridge hooks (single useRegistryDrag, useThree get/set instead of useStore). Made kinds tree item ids unique with index suffix. Removed ineffective frame-ancestors CSP meta from puzzle 2d/3d/5d play index.html (vite dev server still sets CSP header). Extended vitest aliases for playground renderer boot import. Tests: @puzzle/3d/react 86/86, @puzzle/3d/play vitest 14/14, playground renderer 13/13; e2e skipped (Playwright browser not installed).
